extensionDescription.message: Labels every post and reply on X (Substance, Humor, Chit-chat, Promo, Junk, AI-written) with TypeSafe Jev. You choose what to hide.

categorySubstanceDescription.message: Insight, news, real discussion — something to learn or think about

categoryChitchatDescription.message: Personal updates, photos, reactions, emoji replies

categoryPromoDescription.message: Selling or pushing a product, course, newsletter, waitlist

topicDescription.message: Not about tech: gossip, relationships, entertainment, sports, politics, lifestyle, memes with no technical angle

aiDescription.message: Reads like ChatGPT wrote it: “It's not X. It's Y.”, rule-of-three lists, emoji bullets, buzzwords, zero personal detail

topicDescriptionSuffix.message: . Applies on top of any label; replies are judged by the post they answer.

aiDescriptionSuffix.message: . Applies on top of any label.

strictRelaxedDescription.message: Only clearly non-tech posts are hidden

strictStrictDescription.message: Anything not clearly tech is hidden

optionsHeaderDescription.message: Keep your X feed to substantive tech. Every post gets a label; you choose which to hide.

optionsConnectionDescription.message: Labels come from TypeSafe Jev. Cost is calculated from Jev's reported input tokens.

optionsLabelsDescription.message: Changes apply to open pages right away.

optionsFilterRepliesDescription.message: Replies under a post are labelled and hidden the same way. The post you opened is never hidden.

optionsShowLabelsDescription.message: One small tag next to the author name. The AI-written % only appears when it is 40% or higher.

optionsHideSidebarDescription.message: Right column keeps only the search box; Premium upsell, Today's News, Trending and Who to follow are removed.

optionsModeHide.message: Collapsed to one line, with Show / Hide

optionsPeopleDescription.message: One handle per line, without @. Also available from ⋯ on any hidden post.

optionsStopPhrasesDescription.message: Matched locally before Jev. A match labels the post Bait, instantly and free.

statusConnectedTo.message: Connected to $1. Open x.com — Sift is on.

statusCacheCleared.message: Cache cleared — posts will be re-labelled

contentUpdated.message: Sift was updated — reload this page to keep filtering.

contentSetupKey.message: Sift needs a TypeSafe API key to start filtering.

contentKeyRejected.message: Sift: TypeSafe rejected the API key.
